## Details

<a id="check_turn_around"></a>
### [`check_turn_around`](../../../../src/combat/turn_around.asm#L6) `$90CD`

*routine*

Runs when turn_request bit 7 is set. When a fighter does move $84 at frame 0, both fighters start move $9d (turn around).

- **Called from:** [`$80EE`](../../../../src/main/main_loop.asm#L24)
- **Reads:** [`turn_request`](../../memory-map.md#turn_request), [`fighter_move`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_move), [`fighter_pose`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_pose), [`cur_fighter`](../../memory-map.md#cur_fighter)
- **Writes:** [`cur_fighter`](../../memory-map.md#cur_fighter), [`fighter_move_lock`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_move_lock), [`fighter_move`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_move), [`fighter_move_step`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_move_step)
